name: Soft pretzel
about: A warm, chewy pretzel that is a classic Philadelphia snack. Locals eat it plain or with mustard.
tip: Buy one fresh from the market and eat it while it is warm.

name: Handmade hard candy
about: A long-running family candy shop in Philadelphia. Its hard candies are a sweet local souvenir.
tip: Hard candy is easy to pack and carry home, so it is a good choice for travel.
